WatchFooter.home: Xët wu njëkk bu Jesus Film Project
WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Beneen AI ak xamle ak seede
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Jëfandikoo boppam bu xibaar yi ci xët wii ci sistemu artificial intelligence, war na am seede. Ñépp AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, walla beneen system bu automaatik bu jëfandikoo walla génne xibaar yu jëfandikoo xët wii ngir jàngat, am xam-xam, wone tontu, walla joxe service ci jëfandikoo yi walla clientele, war nañu leeral Jesus Film Project ni sapu xibaar bi, te jëfandikoo njëkkal bu leer, bu jub ci xët wii foo xibaar boobu jëfandikoo walla wone. Woneel sunu <terms>Jëfandikoo yi</terms>.

WatchHomePromo.title: Message bi du soppi. Yoonu nit ñi di xool moo soppi.
WatchHomePromo.description: Nu ngi tàmbali taxawaayu vidéo bi ak tool yu nu, nu nekkaat liir yu xamxam bu yàgg ci platforms yi nit ñi xam, xool, ak sàmm fi kañ.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Dëkkuwaay filimi bi gëna ñuul ci àddina
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Lu yàgg ci yoonu traduire bi, ci ndimbal bu partner yu dëgg, dafa sos dëkkuwaay bu am junniy language tracks ngir nit ñi man a degg xibaaru Yeesu ci làkk bu leen di xas.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Amal xibaaru wóor ci form yu bees
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Nu ngi tàmbali defaat naka lañuy wax xibaaru Gospel bi ci loxo, nu takk traductions yu wóor ak form yu bees ngir message bi man a dox ci platform yi, culture yi, ak screen yi.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Du reer doŋŋ. Benn team bu mission la.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project mooy equipe bu àdduna bu translators, media specialists, editors, ak creators yu di wone xam-xam bu yàgg ci tool yu jàppale disciple-makers ci fan yi yépp.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsTitle: Platform bu jéego yi ci topp
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Jokkale viewers ak jikko yu am solo ci yoonu ngëm, ngir ñu man a jëmbat ci community, Scripture, walla mission.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Media library bu Christian bu am junniy vidéos, films, ak resources ci làkk yu bari ngir ministry ak evangelism ci àdduna siiw.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Jëfandikoo vidéo, sàmm content, jokk ni viewers, ak analytics yu def ngir ministries man a lakk nit ñu bari ak doxal bu baax.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Jàppale sos <highlight>generasyon bu bees bi</highlight> yu mission tool yi
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Nu ngi woo practitioners, creators, ak partners ci early access. Toppal tool yu bees ci jëkk, jox feedback, ak jàppale def products yu ñu def ngir mission bu dëgg.
